QUOTE: Async `entropic.ask` worker | `src/facade/external_bridge.cpp:1158` | Detached | ... Detached async workers can outlive the handle. ... It is detached and not tracked. `ExternalBridge::stop()` drains only the client threads.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the detached, untracked thread and notes it can outlive the handle with no join. It doesn't say outright that it is the *only* detached thread, but it presents it as "the one real hazard" and every other thread is joined.
